summary: Iteration 2 backend validation of PunyaVerse: Razorpay (real INR test keys), VIP Darshan slot inventory + booking, WebSocket auth-gated notifications, /api/routes/optimize, and persistent notifications. Wrote 24 new pytest cases; all PASS. Full regression of iteration-1 (46 tests) also re-run — all PASS. Total 70/70 green. Found and fixed 1 minor bug: vip-darshan/book was returning the booking dict after motor's insert_one which leaked MongoDB ObjectId (_id) into the response and caused 500. Applied targeted fix: `booking.pop('_id', None)` before return.

minor.issue: [FIXED in this iteration] After motor.insert_one mutates dict adding ObjectId _id, endpoint returned booking causing FastAPI/jsonable_encoder 500 (ObjectId not iterable). Fixed by popping _id before return in /app/backend/routes_extra.py.

Optional: rate-limit /api/payments/razorpay/order (each call hits Razorpay API and creates a DB row even before user pays).

critical_code_review_comments: routes_extra.py: insert_one(booking) → return booking pattern leaked ObjectId — FIXED. Same pattern should be checked in other modules; spot-check passed.
razorpay verify success path: correctly updates payment_transactions + bookings + writes notification document. HMAC-SHA256(order|payment_id, secret) verified against real Razorpay format.
razorpay verify failure path: payment_transactions marked 'failed' but booking remains pending_payment — verified correct (test_verify_bad_signature passes; manual inspection of route).
WebSocket auth: bad token sends {'error':'auth_failed'} then closes — verified. Good UX.
WebSocket: no per-connection rate limit on ping spam; benign but worth noting.

notify_user: in-memory _active_connections dict is single-process. If backend scales horizontally, WS notifications will miss users connected to other replicas. Mongo persistence covers retrieval, but real-time push won't work cross-replica. Acceptable for current single-pod deployment.

VIP slot capacity decrement is not atomic with the capacity check (race window between find_one and $inc). For high contention, should use findOneAndUpdate with conditional capacity guard. Low risk at current scale.
/api/routes/optimize: stops filtered by 'lat and lng' truthiness — coords of 0 (equator/prime meridian) would be dropped. Not an issue for Indian temples (all positive lat/lng), but worth noting.
RZP_KEY_SECRET is read into module-level constant — fine, but never logged or exposed via API (verified).
razorpay webhook signature check uses RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET with RZP_KEY_SECRET fallback — works for test mode but should set distinct webhook secret in production.

rca of the issue: Bug RCA: POST /api/vip-darshan/book was returning HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Root cause — motor's insert_one() mutates the passed dict by adding a BSON ObjectId under the '_id' key. The handler then returned this same dict, which FastAPI tried to serialize via jsonable_encoder; ObjectId isn't JSON-serializable, raising TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"). Reproduction: any authenticated POST to /api/vip-darshan/book with a valid slot_id. Mitigation applied: in /app/backend/routes_extra.py vip_book() add `booking.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one and before return. Verified by re-running TestVIPDarshan suite — 9/9 pass. Same defensive pattern should be applied wherever an inserted dict is later returned (recommend: always use {'_id': 0} projection on subsequent reads, OR construct response dict separately from insert payload).
